# Sherlog

> An AI on-call investigator for microservice outages that has to prove its answer. Claude investigates with read-only tools and cites the tool calls behind each suspect; plain code checks every citation, a blast-radius check asks whether the answer explains every broken service, and a replay with the answer rolled back shows whether the outage stops. Below 80% confidence or with an unverified citation, it hands the outage to a human.

Read this before quoting any number: the benchmark (132 normal and 44 hard-mode outages, with a decoy in hard mode) runs on a simulated 11-service shop that this project wrote, so the numbers are optimistic. In the simulator, rolling back the true cause is exactly what clears the fault, so the rollback replay measures the gate, not accuracy in the field, and uploaded telemetry gets no rollback test. A no-AI call-graph rule comes close to the agent: 99% vs 100% cause-first on normal outages, 91% vs 98% in hard mode, a difference that could be chance on benchmarks this size.

Everything here is free and needs no key, except live investigations (POST /api/break and /api/investigate), which call Claude and are limited to 6 an hour per visitor and 200 a day.

## Pages

- [Story page](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/): what Sherlog does, told with a recorded outage, a guessing game and the benchmark
- [Console](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/console): break a service live, replay a recorded outage for free ([#41](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/console#replay/41) is the walk-through), read the evidence, upload your own telemetry
- [Status](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/status): live mode, recorded outages, today's live runs and the deployed version
- [API reference](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/reference): every route, generated from the code; the schema itself is at [/openapi.json](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/openapi.json), and [Swagger UI](https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/docs) tries each route

## MCP connector

- Endpoint: `https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/mcp`, the Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP: JSON-RPC 2.0, one JSON answer per POST, no session, no authentication. Protocol revisions 2026-07-28 (per-request metadata, `server/discover`) and 2025-03-26 to 2025-11-25 (`initialize` handshake).
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http sherlog https://sherlog-jade.vercel.app/mcp`
- Tools, all free and read-only, none calling Claude: `list_recorded_outages` (the recorded investigations, numbered), `get_recorded_verdict` (one investigation: tool calls, verdict, citation checks, blast radius, rollback, truth), `triage_incident` (the no-AI checks on a sherlog-incident/1 document), `sample_incident` (a sample document, shop or custom call graph), `benchmark_summary` (the headline numbers and their caveats)
- [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/shaunmortal/sherlog/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): how to connect, each tool with an example call and answer

## HTTP API

- `GET /api/health`: live mode, recorded outages, today's live runs, version
- `GET /api/meta`: the shop's services, call graph, faults and metrics, the models and the benchmark tables
- `GET /api/replays`: the recorded outages, numbered, with hard mode, caught and model
- `GET /api/replays/{number}`: one recorded investigation's events, as a live run streams them
- `GET /api/sample-incident?graph=shop|custom`: a sample upload, culprit removed
- `POST /api/triage`: the no-AI checks on an upload: alarm, z-score and robust rankings, blast radius
- `POST /api/investigate`: the agent on an upload, as server-sent events (live, rate limited)
- `POST /api/break`: break a service in a fresh simulated shop and stream the investigation (live, rate limited)
- `POST /mcp`: the MCP endpoint above
- `GET /llms.txt`: this file

## Upload format

- `sherlog-incident/1`: 10 minutes at one reading every 5 s (120 ticks) of `latency_ms`, `error_rate`, `cpu_pct` and `memory_mb` for every service, optional log lines, and an optional call graph in `calls` (2 to 40 services under their own names; without it, the shop's 11). Bodies over 2 MB get a 413; a bad document gets a 422 naming the field.
- [docs/bring-your-own.md](https://github.com/shaunmortal/sherlog/blob/main/docs/bring-your-own.md): the format, its checks and limits, and a converter for metric range-query exports

## Code and evidence

- [Repository](https://github.com/shaunmortal/sherlog): Python and FastAPI, MIT License
- [README](https://github.com/shaunmortal/sherlog#readme): how it works, every results table, limitations
- [runs/evidence.json](https://github.com/shaunmortal/sherlog/blob/main/runs/evidence.json): every benchmark number, recomputed from the recorded runs by `python bench.py --report` with no API calls
- [runs/](https://github.com/shaunmortal/sherlog/tree/main/runs): every recorded investigation, with each tool call and the model's reasoning
